svg.title: Three places the reason could go
svg.text: Choice 1: three places the reason could go
A: one line under the bottom buttons
B: A, and the update box says soNot picked
C: B, and the Checklist heading says soNot picked
Counting the top bar, B shows “View only” three times on one screen and C four times.
A: one line under the bottom buttons
B: A, and the update box says soNot picked
C: B, and the Checklist heading says soNot picked
On a phone the top bar does not say “View only”, so A shows the words once.
50% = greyed in a view. Dashed top edge: the 1280 page continues up to the bar.
